candidateTools.title: Commercial Cryogenic Liquid Nitrogen Quick-Freezer Belt Embrittlement & Oxygen Depletion Safety Modeler
candidateTools.intent: Models -320°F (-196°C) industrial liquid nitrogen immersion and tunnel quick-freezers, 304 vs 316 stainless steel wire mesh belt cryogenic ductile-to-brittle transition temperature (DBTT), conveyor drive thermal contraction jamming, boil-off expansion ratios (1:694), and CGA P-12 scullery oxygen depletion asphyxiation sensor interlocks.

candidateTools.title: Commercial High-Pressure Retort Autoclave Clostridium botulinum Fo Sterilization & Can Seam Stress Modeler
candidateTools.intent: Models 250°F (121°C) commercial batch retort autoclave thermal lethality Fo kinetics against Clostridium botulinum spores, saturated steam vs water immersion counter-pressure air overpressure control, and double-seam tinplate hermetic buckling margins under ASME BPVC Section VIII.

candidateTools.title: Commercial Industrial Freeze Dryer Sublimation Condenser Ice Cake Collapse & Vacuum Seal Modeler
candidateTools.intent: Models -50°C to +40°C industrial food freeze-drying shelf heating profiles, pirani gauge vacuum sublimation rates (<0.1 mbar), condenser coil ice cake sublimation collapse limits, and elastomer vacuum door seal permeation margins under FDA 21 CFR § 113.

candidateTools.title: Commercial Steam Tunnel Continuous Shrink Sleeve Packaging Condensate Corrosion & Bottle Burst Modeler
candidateTools.intent: Models high-speed commercial beverage & sauce line continuous steam shrink sleeve tunnels, saturated steam condensation heat transfer, PET vs glass bottle thermal shock hoop stress bursting, and 316L stainless tunnel plenum acid sanitizing corrosion.
